samples.summary: Cut-paste of a spill anchor alone leaves permanently orphaned ghost cells at the source
samples.evidence: `moveRangeTo` was fixed by this diff (the new `movedSpillAnchors` loop, sheet.ts:2600-2616) to delete the ghosts of an anchor that travels. The equivalent path in `paste` was not. Cut just the anchor A1 of `=MUNIT(2)` (source range A1:A1) and paste at D5: `grid` contains only `D5`, so `staleGhostSources`/`staleGhostDests` stay empty; the cut source-clear loop at 2411-2422 deletes A1 (`sourceCell?.spillAnchor` is falsy for an anchor) but never touches B1/A2/B2, which keep `spillAnchor: 'A1'`. Nothing owns them afterwards: `setData` returns early on `existing?.spillAnchor` (sheet.ts:1206) and `removeData` skips them (sheet.ts:1284), so the cells become permanently uneditable zombie values. The same loop also never calls `clearSpillBlockers(oldAnchorSref)`, leaving a stale blocker→dead-anchor entry in `spillBlockers`.

samples.summary: Copy-pasting a spilled range now yields #REF! at the destination (regression from materializing ghosts)
samples.evidence: For a non-cut internal paste the new loop materializes every ghost into a static value (`delete materialized.spillAnchor`). The pasted anchor loses its spill metadata in `relocateGrid` (clipboard.ts:26 writes only `{f, s}`) and is recalculated; `findSpillBlocker` (sheet.ts:1023) now sees those materialized values as user data with no `spillAnchor` and blocks, so the copied anchor renders `#REF!` surrounded by stale static values. Before this change the pasted ghosts kept `spillAnchor` and were transparently overwritten by the new anchor's spill, so copy-paste of a spill worked. No test covers the copy (non-cut) case.

samples.summary: Autofill over an existing live spill anchor orphans that anchor's ghosts
samples.evidence: The autofill write loop (touched by this diff at 2865) only guards `existingDest?.spillAnchor` (2861). When the destination cell is itself a live spill *anchor* (`spillRows`/`spillCols` set), `store.set(normalizedDest, nextCell)` at 2903/2932 overwrites it with a plain value without running the ghost-cleanup contract that `removeData` (1291-1305) and the new `clearCellForOverwrite` (1082-1097) follow, and without `clearSpillBlockers(destSref)`. The former ghosts stay in the store pointing at an sref that no longer holds a formula, so nothing can ever delete them.

samples.summary: Post-paste selection shrinks because deleted ghost entries are removed from the grid before selectPastedRange
samples.evidence: `grid.delete(sref)` at 2330 removes stale ghost entries; `selectPastedRange(grid)` at 2439 computes the pasted bounding box from the same map. Cut-pasting a 2x2 spill (A1:B2 -> D5) leaves grid = {D5}, so the code takes the single-cell branch (2460) and selects only D5 instead of the D5:E6 rectangle the user pasted.

samples.summary: Remote-change reload path does not rebuild the spill blocker map
samples.evidence: `reloadDimensions` reloads dimensions, styles, merges, freeze, filter, hidden and pivot state after a remote change but never calls `loadSpillBlockers()`, unlike `initialize` (worksheet.ts:424) and `Sheet.undo`/`redo` (sheet.ts:5103/5140). Since merges themselves now block spills (`findSpillBlocker`, sheet.ts:1021), a remote merge/unmerge or remote cell edit leaves the local `spillBlockers` map stale, so clearing the blocker locally never re-queues the blocked anchor and its `#REF!` sticks.

samples.summary: Moving data onto another anchor's ghost cells does not re-queue that anchor
samples.evidence: `setGrid(movedGrid)` (2567) can overwrite cells that are ghosts of a spill anchor located outside both source and destination. Those positions are not in `skippedGhosts` (which only contains ghosts found inside the source range), so `clearCellForOverwrite` is never invoked for them and the owning anchor is never added to `unblockedAnchors`. The anchor keeps `spillRows/spillCols` and is not recalculated, leaving a half-overwritten spill that shows no `#REF!` and whose remaining ghosts are still marked as owned.

samples.summary: refusalMessage uses a default branch instead of exhaustive switch
samples.evidence: `default: return "Can't autofill across merged cells..."` maps every future `RangeOpRefusal` variant to the autofill message. Adding a new refusal reason silently produces a wrong user-facing message rather than a compile error.

verdict.reason: Verified independently. In `paste`, the ghost-handling loop (sheet.ts:2327-2341) only inspects cells present in the pasted grid, so cutting an anchor alone (source range = A1:A1) leaves `staleGhostSources`/`staleGhostDests` (2289-2290) empty. The cut source-clear loop (2411-2422) then deletes the anchor via `store.delete` because `sourceCell?.spillAnchor` is falsy for an anchor (anchors carry spillRows/spillCols per calculator.ts:128-133), without enumerating and deleting its ghosts and without calling `clearSpillBlockers(oldAnchorSref)`. Every sibling path does perform that cleanup: setData (1211-1230), removeData (1291-1305), clearCellForOverwrite (1053-1096), and the new moveRangeTo `movedSpillAnchors` loop (2600-2616) which explicitly documents this exact hazard. The orphaned ghosts remain permanently uneditable: setData returns early on `existing?.spillAnchor` (1206) and removeData skips ghosts (1284); calculator.ts:74-85 only clears ghosts for an anchor it recalculates at that anchor's own position, and the anchor at A1 no longer exists; loadSpillBlockers (1039-1051) rebuilds only the blocker map. A repo-wide grep for `spillAnchor` in packages/sheets/src shows no other cleanup site. Existing test coverage (test/sheet/calculation.test.ts:385-404) cuts the full A1:B2 footprint, so the anchor-only case is genuinely unhandled. Reachable by a normal user gesture (select anchor, cut, paste) and results in corrupted, uneditable cells plus a stale blocker entry.

verdict.reason: The code is present exactly as described and the failure path is reachable. In paste()'s internal-paste branch, sheet.ts:2327-2341 materializes every ghost (`delete materialized.spillAnchor`) whenever the paste is not a cut — the delete/staleGhost handling at 2329-2337 is gated on `isCut`, so a plain copy of an anchor+its ghosts keeps static values at the destination footprint. relocateGrid (clipboard.ts:24-26) writes formula cells as `{f, s}` only, so the pasted anchor is recalculated; store.setGrid (memory.ts:137-143) has already persisted the materialized `{v}` cells, and findSpillBlocker (sheet.ts:1016-1029) treats a cell with `v` and no `spillAnchor` as a blocker, so calculator.ts:105-119 writes `ErrValue.REF` with `spillBlocked: true` at the pasted anchor and writes no ghosts. Nothing on the non-cut path clears the destination footprint (staleGhostDests/clearCellForOverwrite at sheet.ts:2331 and 2393-2399 are cut-only), and no guard elsewhere prevents this. Tests cover only the cut case (calculation.test.ts:251, 385-404). Copy-pasting a working spilled range therefore yields #REF! plus stale values — a major correctness regression on a core flow.

verdict.reason: Verified as described. sheet.ts:2861 guards only ghosts (`existingDest?.spillAnchor`); a destination that is a live spill anchor (spillRows/spillCols set, not blocked) falls through to `store.set(normalizedDest, nextCell)` at 2903/2932 with no ghost sweep and no `clearSpillBlockers(destSref)`, unlike every other overwrite path (removeData 1291-1305, setData 1211-1230, clearCellForOverwrite 1082-1097, calculator.ts:74-85). Nothing repairs it afterward: calculate skips formula-less cells (calculator.ts:49-51), so re-queuing via recalculateWithUnblocked (sheet.ts:2940) is a no-op, and the orphaned ghosts are unreachable by removeData (skips ghosts, 1284) and setData (early return, 1206). Concretely reachable: A3=`=SEQUENCE(3)` spilling A3:A5, then autofill A1:A2 down to A5 — row-major order hits anchor A3 first and overwrites it, while A4/A5 are skipped as ghosts, leaving permanently undeletable cells pointing at an sref with no formula. Autofill's only entry guard is the merge refusal at 2785-2788, and autofill.test.ts has no spill coverage. Broken invariant / stale unrecoverable data — in-lane and blocking.

finding.summary: mergeSelection's new re-spill can write spill ghosts into a merged block, and setCell normalizes them onto the merge anchor (overwriting it)
finding.evidence: mergeSelection now consumes blockers (line 4452) and re-queues the anchor via recalculateWithUnblocked (4461) AFTER setMerge/rebuildMergeCoverMap (4457-4459). The anchor then re-spills into cells that are now merge-covered. calculator.ts:141 writes ghosts with sheet.setCell(ghostRef, ...), and Sheet.setCell (sheet.ts:954) does store.set(this.normalizeRefToAnchor(ref), cell) — so a ghost destined for a covered cell is written to the MERGE ANCHOR cell instead, clobbering whatever the merge anchor held. The new test 'spill re-attempts when merging erases the blocking cell' hits exactly this: A4=MINVERSE spills 2x2 into A4:B5 while B3:B4 is merged, so the B4 ghost lands in B3 (the merge anchor) — the test only asserts A4 and never checks B3. Worse, later cleanup (removeData sheet.ts:1186-1188, calculator.ts:78-82) looks up ghosts with the RAW ref (B4), so the ghost stranded in B3 is never removed: permanently orphaned, read-only content in the merged cell.

verdict.reason: The claimed clobbering path is closed by an existing guard that runs before the re-spill. In mergeSelection, store.setMerge + this.merges.set + rebuildMergeCoverMap() (sheet.ts:4623-4625) all complete BEFORE recalculateWithUnblocked is awaited (sheet.ts:4630) — the ordering is explicitly documented at sheet.ts:4627-4629. When the re-queued anchor is recalculated, findSpillBlocker checks merge membership FIRST (sheet.ts:1021: `if (this.getMergeForRef(target)) return sref;`), resolving through the freshly rebuilt mergeCoverMap (sheet.ts:803-807, 819-827). So the covered cell (B4 in the reviewer's scenario) is returned as a blocker and calculator.ts takes the spillBlocked branch (calculator.ts:107-119, which `continue`s), never reaching the ghost write at calculator.ts:133. No ghost is normalized onto the merge anchor, so the downstream orphan-cleanup concern is moot as well. The doc comment at sheet.ts:1005-1009 documents this exact failure mode as the reason the merge check exists. Additionally, the reviewer's account of the test is factually wrong: the test at calculation.test.ts:263-294 sets up precisely the described scenario (B4='BLOCKER', A4='=MINVERSE(A1:B2)', then merge B3:B4) and asserts BOTH that A4 remains '#REF!' (line 283) AND that B3 — the merge anchor claimed to be clobbered — is still empty (line 284), contradicting the claim that the test only asserts A4 and never checks B3.

finding.summary: Cut-paste still copies spill ghosts to the destination and leaves the source ghosts behind — the exact hazard this delta fixed only for moveRangeTo
finding.evidence: moveRangeTo now skips ghosts when building movedGrid and deletes stale ones (sheet.ts:2386-2390, 2446), documenting that a copied ghost 'reads as user data blocking the anchor's re-spill'. The cut-paste path in the same delta was left untouched: cut() -> fetchGrid copies ghost cells verbatim, relocateGrid (clipboard.ts:28) does newGrid.set(newSref, {...cell}) preserving spillAnchor, and setGrid writes them at the destination as cells carrying a spillAnchor that names a sref which no longer spills there. Meanwhile the source loop at sheet.ts:2259 (`if (sourceCell?.spillAnchor) continue`) leaves the original ghosts in place. Both copies are then read-only forever (setData sheet.ts:1095 returns, removeData sheet.ts:1173 skips, autofill sheet.ts:2692 skips), so the user cannot clear them, and the pasted phantom will block any future spill there.

verdict.reason: The described defect is not present. The finding claims the cut-paste path was left untouched so ghosts are written at the destination with `spillAnchor` intact and source ghosts are stranded. In fact `paste()` post-processes the relocated grid at sheet.ts:2327-2341: any cell with a `spillAnchor` is either deleted from the pasted grid (when `isCut && sourceGrid.has(cell.spillAnchor)`, recording `staleGhostSources`/`staleGhostDests`) or materialized via `delete materialized.spillAnchor`. So `setGrid` never writes a phantom ghost at the destination. The stranded-source half is handled too: sheet.ts:2386-2392 deletes the stale source ghosts and sheet.ts:2393-2399 clears the corresponding destination offsets via `clearCellForOverwrite`, both before `recalculateWithUnblocked`. The `if (sourceCell?.spillAnchor) continue` the finding cites is at sheet.ts:2416 and runs after that deletion, so it only skips ghosts still owned by a live anchor outside the cut range — the same intentional contract as moveRangeTo's `!staleGhosts.has(sref)` guard at sheet.ts:2626. `paste()` (sheet.ts:2292) is the only consumer of the cut buffer per a full `copyBuffer` grep, so there is no bypassing call site, and calculation.test.ts:385-404 pins the behavior (asserts empty source and `spillAnchor === 'D5'`, the new anchor). The finding's line numbers are also stale by ~150 lines, consistent with it having been written against a version predating this handling.
